identity.title: ALMA Observations of the Host Galaxy of GRB 090423 at z = 8.23: Deep Limits on Obscured Star Formation 630 Million Years after the Big Bang

paper_type_evidence.quote: We present rest-frame far-infrared (FIR) and optical observations of the host galaxy of GRB 090423 at $z=8.23$ from the Atacama Large Millimeter Array (ALMA) and the *Spitzer Space Telescope*, respectively.
